annotation.title_clean: The Proposed Regulation of Artificial Intelligence and Robotics in Kenya: An Appraisal of the Kenya Robotics and Artificial Intelligence Association Bill, 2023
annotation.title_en: The Proposed Regulation of Artificial Intelligence and Robotics in Kenya: An Appraisal of the Kenya Robotics and Artificial Intelligence Association Bill, 2023
annotation.venue: Journal of Conflict Management and Sustainable Development (Journalofcmsd) Vol 11(3)
named_instruments_referenced: Kenya Robotics and Artificial Intelligence Association Bill 2023
annotation.summary_en: A Kenyan legal journal article reviews the Kenya Robotics and Artificial Intelligence Association Bill, 2023. It credits the bill for creating a professional body but finds its regulatory scope narrow and its enforcement powers weak. The bill also lacks guiding principles. The author recommends amendments covering principles, enforcement, mandatory disclosure and inventory of AI systems, and collaboration between agencies.
key_provisions_or_claims: The bill would set up a professional association to advise government and set industry standards for AI and robotics
The bill's regulatory scope and enforcement powers are too limited
The bill has no guiding regulatory principles, which leaves its ethical basis unclear
Recommends mandatory inventory and disclosure of AI systems in use
Recommends mandatory collaboration between agencies, drawing on international practice such as the US Executive Order
